actual: Vouchers can be selected or entered at checkout, but there is no voucher wallet or Claimed state.
remark: Draft: Add claiming and a wallet if this flow is required.

actual: One voucher discounts the whole cart rather than a particular store group. The checkout also does not add the shipping charge in this example.
remark: Draft: Apply store vouchers to the correct store and include shipping separately.

actual: Only one voucher can be selected at a time. Store, platform, and shipping vouchers cannot be combined as in the example.
remark: Draft: Add the agreed voucher-stacking rules.

actual: The voucher is rejected below its minimum spend and allowed at the minimum. The message gives the required spend rather than how much more is needed.
remark: Draft: Add a helpful message such as Spend ₱0.01 More.

actual: Expired, future, exhausted, and unknown voucher codes are rejected with the same Invalid or Expired message.
remark: Draft: Give a specific reason for each unavailable voucher.

actual: There is no per-buyer usage check, so the same buyer is not specifically blocked from reusing the voucher.
remark: Draft: Apply the limit separately to each buyer.

actual: Checkout checks the minimum spend again before placing an order. The applied voucher is not automatically removed with a notice when the amount falls below the minimum.
remark: Draft: Remove an ineligible voucher and update the total clearly.

actual: A percentage voucher is capped at its maximum discount, and the discount is rounded to two decimal places.
remark: Draft: Confirm each amount around the minimum and cap.

actual: Shipping is not calculated separately, and shipping vouchers are not handled as a separate discount on that fee.
remark: Draft: Apply free shipping to the delivery fee rather than the merchandise.

actual: The voucher discount cannot reduce the merchandise total below zero. There is no separate shipping charge in the current total.
remark: Draft: Keep the total non-negative and handle shipping separately.

actual: Voucher calculations use the current sale price, so a sale item can still qualify. The extra shipping amount in the example is not included.
remark: Draft: Confirm the sale discount and shipping breakdown together.

actual: Cancelling an order does not restore the voucher's usage or return it to a voucher wallet.
remark: Draft: Return an eligible voucher after cancellation.

actual: An address can be saved without making it the default, but the form uses typed location fields. My Addresses opens the add form instead of a saved-address list.
remark: Draft: Show saved addresses and provide the location dropdowns described in the case.

actual: Province, city, and barangay are entered manually on the address form. There is no linked Region list that clears the selections below it.
remark: Draft: Add linked location dropdowns to avoid mismatched addresses.

actual: Empty recipient, phone, street, city, province, and barangay fields are required. There is no separate Region field on this form.
remark: Draft: Required-field checks are present, but the Region part differs from the test.

actual: The address form accepts a phone number without checking the required Philippine format. Short and long numbers are not specifically blocked.
remark: Draft: Accept only valid 09 or +63 mobile numbers.

actual: There is no ten-address limit, so adding an eleventh address is not specifically blocked.
remark: Draft: Add the address limit and explain it when the buyer reaches it.

actual: A new address can be marked as default, and checkout prefers it. There is no saved-address list for changing an existing address to default.
remark: Draft: Let buyers choose the default from their saved addresses.

actual: The app has no delete option in a saved-address list. The address-delete action also does not require choosing a new default first.
remark: Draft: Keep one default address and make address management available.

actual: Existing orders refer to the saved address, so changing that address can change the order's address details too.
remark: Draft: Keep the original delivery address with each order.

actual: Address changes are restricted to the signed-in buyer's own addresses. Another buyer's address is not included in that lookup.
remark: Draft: Confirm with two test accounts before marking it passed.

actual: There is no Use My Location option on the address form. The buyer needs to enter the address manually.
remark: Not supported.

actual: Phone is set up for a phone keyboard, while recipient and street use text input. Reaching Save with the phone keyboard open still needs checking.
remark: Draft: Check the keyboard and Save button on a phone.

actual: Adding the same product and variation again increases the quantity on the existing cart line.
remark: Draft: Confirm three units produce one line and the expected subtotal.

actual: Different variations of the same product stay on separate cart lines with their own prices.
remark: Draft: Confirm both selected variations and amounts in the cart.

actual: Items are shown in one list instead of being grouped under their store names.
remark: Draft: Group items by store to make the cart easier to review.

actual: Selecting and deselecting changes the subtotal shown in the cart. Checkout still loads the whole cart, including unselected items.
remark: Draft: Send only the selected items to checkout.

actual: Quantity cannot go below one, and an amount above the available stock is rejected.
remark: Draft: Confirm the one- and twenty-unit boundaries with the prepared stock.

actual: The cart uses the current selling price when it is loaded again. A changed price is reflected after reloading the cart.
remark: Draft: Confirm the price and subtotal both change to the new amount.

actual: Unavailable items are not clearly disabled for selection. A stock problem in one item can also stop checkout for the rest of the cart.
remark: Draft: Mark unavailable items and let the buyer check out the available ones.

actual: The cart belongs to the buyer account and is kept after signing out. Loading the same cart on a second device still needs checking.
remark: Draft: Confirm the same quantities appear after login on both devices.

actual: Removing an item deletes its cart line and reloads the remaining items and subtotal.
remark: Draft: Confirm the removed line stays gone when the cart is reopened.

actual: Cart updates and removals are limited to items in the signed-in buyer's own cart.
remark: Draft: Confirm another buyer's item cannot be changed through a direct request.

actual: The displayed quantity changes after a successful save rather than immediately. Failed updates show an error, but reconnecting still needs checking.
remark: Draft: Confirm the displayed quantity matches what was actually saved.

actual: The bottom cart badge counts item lines rather than individual units. It loads when the bottom menu is created, so immediate changes are not guaranteed.
remark: Draft: Keep the badge updated after each add or removal.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: The new name and photo stayed saved after signing in again, but the account details did not refresh straight after saving. The bottom menu also partly covered Save.
remark: Refresh the account details after saving and keep Save visible.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: An empty first name was rejected, but Juan123 and a one-letter name were still accepted.
remark: Reject names containing numbers and add a minimum name length.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: The password changed successfully. The old password was rejected, and the new password worked when signing in again.
remark: Worked.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: The password-change form did not ask for the current password before saving a new one.
remark: Require the current password before allowing a change.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: A short password was rejected, but a password with no uppercase letter was accepted.
remark: Apply all password rules, not just the minimum length.

actual: There is no option to change the email address on the profile screen, so the new-email verification step is unavailable.
remark: Draft: Add an email-change option with verification.

actual: There is no email-change verification screen for entering a wrong or expired code.
remark: Draft: This depends on having an email-change feature first.

actual: The profile does not offer email editing, so a duplicate replacement email cannot be submitted through this screen.
remark: Draft: Check for duplicate emails when email editing is added.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: A short phone number and another buyer's phone number were both saved without verification.
remark: Reject invalid or duplicate numbers and verify a new number before saving it.

actual: The profile photo picker supports selecting an image. Taking a photo and handling denied camera access still need checking on a phone.
remark: Draft: A phone is needed to check the camera and permission messages.

basis: observed in Chrome before testing was stopped
actual: Another signed-in session stayed active after the password was changed.
remark: Sign out the other sessions when the password changes; phone behaviour still needs checking.

actual: Sign-in is remembered, and logging out returns to the login screen. Force-closing the phone app and using the phone's Back button still need checking.
remark: Draft: Confirm this on a phone before marking it passed.

actual: The app supports text conversations with a seller, but not photo attachments or a product card in the conversation. The main product Chat shortcut opens the message list.
remark: Draft: Open the correct seller conversation and include the product and photo.

actual: Messages allow up to 2,000 characters, so a 1,001-character message is not blocked by the stated limit. Attachments are unavailable.
remark: Draft: Apply the agreed message limit and add safe attachment checks.

actual: The notification inbox shows order-history updates and can open the related order. Exactly one notification per change still needs checking.
remark: Draft: Confirm the count and destination for each order update.

actual: There is no flash-sale reminder option or notification linked to the upcoming sale.
remark: Draft: Add reminders if scheduled flash sales are required.

actual: Opening a notification marks it read, and Mark All as Read clears the unread total.
remark: Draft: Confirm the three-to-two-to-zero sequence with three unread updates.

actual: Chat messages do not generate a phone push notification that opens the conversation.
remark: Draft: Add background message notifications and a direct conversation link.

actual: The in-app inbox is separate from phone notification settings, but phone push notifications are not available in this version.
remark: Draft: Check permission behaviour after push notifications are added.

actual: The message text is cleared before sending finishes. A failed send shows an error without keeping an unsent message or offering Retry.
remark: Draft: Keep failed messages available for retry so buyers do not lose their text.

actual: Delivered orders can be rated with stars and a written comment. Review photos, masked names, and the full variation display are not provided as described.
remark: Draft: Complete the review details and photo attachments.

actual: The rating button is shown for delivered orders, but a direct rating submission is not restricted to completed or delivered orders.
remark: Draft: Enforce review eligibility even when the button is bypassed.

actual: Submitting another review updates the existing review instead of creating a second one. The screen does not switch to an Edit-only option.
remark: Draft: Show the existing review and provide Edit instead of another new submission.

actual: Ratings are limited to one through five stars, but comments allow 2,000 characters rather than 500. Review photos are unavailable.
remark: Draft: Apply the agreed text and photo limits.

actual: There is no one-edit limit or thirty-day deadline on changing a review.
remark: Draft: Limit edits and stop changes after the agreed window.

actual: The product's average rating is recalculated from visible reviews. A five-star and a one-star review would give an average of 3.0.
remark: Draft: Confirm both the average and review count on the product and search listing.

actual: There is no camera or multi-photo selection option in the review form.
remark: Draft: Add review photos and enforce the five-photo limit.

actual: There is no Return/Refund option for submitting a damaged-item request with photos.
remark: Draft: Add the return-request form and its order status.

actual: Returns are unavailable before delivery and after delivery, so the intended delivery-based restriction cannot be checked.
remark: Draft: This depends on having a working return-request feature.

actual: There is no return-request window, so the seven-day boundary cannot be checked.
remark: Draft: Add the return window before checking its limits.

actual: There is no return form for entering a description or attaching evidence.
remark: Draft: Add the required description and photo checks with the return feature.

actual: Return-request status, rejection reasons, and an Escalate option are not available.
remark: Draft: Let the buyer follow the request and respond to a rejection.

actual: There is no return-evidence picker for taking or selecting photos.
remark: Draft: Add evidence uploads, then check camera and gallery behaviour on a phone.

actual: A pending or confirmed order can be cancelled after a confirmation message. A reason is not collected, and stock restoration differs for variation purchases.
remark: Draft: Collect the reason and restore stock to the exact variation bought.

actual: Cancellation only asks for confirmation and does not require a reason.
remark: Draft: Ask the buyer to choose a reason before cancelling.

actual: Prepaid orders and automatic refunds are not available. Cancelling also does not restore the voucher's usage.
remark: Draft: Add the refund and voucher-return flow for prepaid cancellations.

actual: Cancel is offered only for pending and confirmed orders. The Ready for Pickup step still needs checking against the seller's order flow.
remark: Draft: Confirm cancellation is unavailable once pickup preparation reaches the agreed cutoff.

actual: Cancel is hidden after the order leaves pending or confirmed, and later cancellation requests are rejected.
remark: Draft: Confirm both the screen and a direct request reject cancellation after shipping.

actual: A repeat cancellation is rejected after the order is already cancelled. Simultaneous taps still need checking to confirm stock is restored only once.
remark: Draft: Confirm one cancellation and one stock restoration.

actual: Opening a category filters the listing to active products in that category. The basket should appear when its test record is available.
remark: Draft: Confirm the complete result list using the prepared test products.

actual: The store page has products, search, sorting, and reviews, but no Home Decor or Lamps category tree.
remark: Draft: Add store categories so buyers can browse by subcategory.

actual: Search supports full names and partial words, ignores spaces at either end, and treats uppercase and lowercase searches alike.
remark: Draft: Confirm all four searches return the basket.

actual: An unmatched search shows a no-results message. The misspelled search does not offer a corrected spelling or suggestion.
remark: Draft: Add a useful suggestion when the search contains a typo.

actual: Search text is treated as text, but a percent sign can match many products instead of being treated literally.
remark: Draft: Handle special search characters without broadening the results unexpectedly.

actual: Searching with an empty box or spaces returns the normal product list.
remark: Draft: The planned behaviour matches; confirm it in the running app.

actual: There is an Under ₱500 shortcut, but no minimum-and-maximum price range to enter the listed amounts.
remark: Draft: Add a price-range filter and reject invalid ranges.

actual: The available shortcuts do not combine rating, category, and seller location as required in this case.
remark: Draft: Keep all selected filters active together and clear them individually.

actual: Price and rating sorting are available, but there is no best-selling sort or control to keep loading more results.
remark: Draft: Complete the sort options and make the remaining products accessible.

actual: Inactive and draft products are excluded from the normal listing and product details. Deleted-product links still need checking with prepared test records.
remark: Draft: Confirm unavailable links show a clear message without exposing the product.

actual: The buyer screens do not show an On Vacation notice or a purchase block for a vacation store.
remark: Draft: Tell buyers when a store is away and block purchases as required.

actual: The keyboard Search action runs the search. Pulling to refresh on Home reloads the general listing rather than keeping the same search results.
remark: Draft: Keep the search term and filters when refreshing.

actual: A failed search shows an error, but there is no dedicated offline message with a Retry button. Reconnecting and searching again still need checking.
remark: Draft: Make the connection problem clear and provide an easy retry.

actual: Checkout combines the cart into one order with one voucher. It does not create separate store orders or include the shipping breakdown in the worked example.
remark: Draft: Split orders by store and show the full discount and shipping breakdown.

actual: Changing the delivery address does not add or update a shipping fee.
remark: Draft: Recalculate shipping for the selected address and store.

actual: There is no shipping calculation based on the parcel's weight, so the one-kilogram boundary is not applied.
remark: Draft: Calculate delivery fees using the agreed weight brackets.

actual: Checkout checks that the address belongs to the buyer but does not block an area that delivery services cannot cover.
remark: Draft: Check delivery coverage before allowing an order.

actual: There is no Note to Seller field on the checkout screen. The order-note allowance also differs from the 200-character rule.
remark: Draft: Add the note field with the agreed character limit.

actual: Cash on Delivery is already selected, so there is no blank payment selection through the checkout screen. A request without a payment method is rejected.
remark: Draft: The payment method is required, but the screen uses a default selection.

actual: Place Order is disabled while an order is being submitted. Repeated or simultaneous submissions still need checking to confirm only one order is saved.
remark: Draft: Confirm one order and one stock deduction after repeated taps.

actual: A changed price is used when the order is placed, but the buyer is not asked to confirm the new amount first.
remark: Draft: Show the new price and ask the buyer to confirm before placing the order.

actual: Stock is checked again before an order is placed. Two buyers ordering at the same moment still need checking.
remark: Draft: Confirm the last unit cannot be sold twice.

actual: An invalidated voucher stops the order with an error, but the voucher and displayed total are not automatically refreshed.
remark: Draft: Remove the invalid voucher and show the corrected total.

actual: Checkout uses the real product prices rather than accepting a replacement total supplied in the order request.
remark: Draft: Confirm a changed request cannot alter the amount charged.

actual: A connection error is shown if the request fails. The app does not check whether the order was already saved before offering another attempt.
remark: Draft: Recover the existing order after a lost response and avoid duplicates.

actual: Checkout selections stay with the open screen. Interruptions, app switching, and reopening after the phone closes the app still need checking.
remark: Draft: Check this on a phone with an address and voucher selected.

actual: A signed-in buyer can save a product to Favorites and remove it again. The heart changes with the saved state returned by that action.
remark: Draft: Confirm the Favorites list and reopened product stay in sync.

actual: Favorites is limited to one saved entry for each buyer and product. Rapid taps and the final heart state still need checking.
remark: Draft: Prevent repeated taps from leaving the heart in the wrong state.

actual: Favorites does not provide the Sold Out and Unavailable placeholders described in this test.
remark: Draft: Keep unavailable items understandable without breaking the list.

actual: Following and unfollowing changes the store's follower count. There is no separate Following list to check.
remark: Draft: Add a list of followed stores and keep it in sync.

actual: Saving a favorite and following a store require the buyer to sign in first.
remark: Draft: Confirm both guest actions return to login without saving anything.

actual: The order tabs are All, To Ship, In Transit, Delivered, and Cancelled. To Pay, Completed, and Return/Refund are not available.
remark: Draft: Match the order tabs to the agreed order flow.

actual: Order details show saved status updates and a basic progress display. The complete hub-to-hub timeline still needs updates from the seller and delivery roles.

actual: There is no Order Received button to move a delivered order to Completed.
remark: Draft: Add buyer confirmation and the corresponding completion step.

actual: Order Received is unavailable before delivery, but it is also unavailable after delivery.
remark: Draft: The intended delivery-based eligibility rule is not complete.

actual: There is no seven-day automatic completion step for delivered orders.
remark: Draft: Add completion after the agreed delivery window.

actual: Order details are limited to orders belonging to the signed-in buyer. Another buyer's order is not included in that lookup.
remark: Draft: Confirm access is refused with two separate test accounts.

actual: Order updates can appear in the in-app inbox, but there is no phone push notification that opens the related order.

actual: A COD order starts under To Ship with payment still pending. The example's ₱500 total differs because checkout does not add the shipping charge.

actual: Cash on Delivery is the only payment option. There is no e-wallet or card payment screen.

actual: There is no online-payment failure screen or Pay Again option.

actual: Checkout does not open a payment gateway, so there is no gateway-cancellation flow.

actual: There is no gateway payment or payment-reference update to check after closing the app.
remark: Draft: This depends on adding the online payment flow first.

actual: There is no automatic cancellation for an unpaid online order.
remark: Draft: Add the unpaid-order deadline if online payments are introduced.

actual: There is no one-hour payment window or Pay action for an unpaid online order.
remark: Draft: The fifty-nine- and sixty-one-minute cases cannot be completed in this version.

actual: The app does not open an e-wallet or return from an e-wallet payment.

actual: There is no online-payment processing screen to leave with Back.
remark: Draft: Add payment recovery and Back handling when this flow is available.

actual: Selecting a variation changes the displayed price. The available-stock text and photo do not change with that selection.

actual: An out-of-stock variation can still be selected. The stock warning comes when the buyer tries to add it to the cart.

actual: The quantity starts at one, and adding more than the available stock is rejected. Quantity is changed with buttons rather than a typing field.

actual: There is no purchase limit that remembers how many units the buyer already bought in earlier orders.

actual: The product page does not show a flash-sale countdown, remaining flash units, or a Claim button for the voucher.

actual: An unavailable product has a Product Not Found state, and inactive products are not returned as available items.

actual: There is no Share action on the product page or a product-link opening flow for another phone.
